def process(
    waterBodyTesting2002,
    waterBodyTesting2003,
    waterBodyTesting2004,
    waterBodyTesting2005,
    waterBodyTesting2006,

    waterBodyTesting2017,
    waterBodyTesting2018,
    waterBodyTesting2019,
    waterBodyTesting2020,
    waterBodyTesting2021,
    waterBodyTesting2022,
    waterBodyTesting2023,
):
    import pandas as pd

    dfs = [
        waterBodyTesting2002,
        waterBodyTesting2003,
        waterBodyTesting2004,
        waterBodyTesting2005,
        waterBodyTesting2006,
        waterBodyTesting2007,
        waterBodyTesting2008,
        waterBodyTesting2009,
        waterBodyTesting2010,
        waterBodyTesting2011,
        waterBodyTesting2012,
        waterBodyTesting2013,
        waterBodyTesting2014,
        waterBodyTesting2015,
        waterBodyTesting2016,
        waterBodyTesting2017,
        waterBodyTesting2018,
        waterBodyTesting2019,
        waterBodyTesting2020,
        waterBodyTesting2021,
        waterBodyTesting2022,
        waterBodyTesting2023,
    ]

    df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

    # Freshwater beaches only
    df = df[df["Beach Type Description"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower().eq("fresh")].copy()

    # Normalize Violation to yes/no; treat any other/unexpected value as missing
    viol = df["Violation"].astype(str).str.strip().str.lower()
    df["violationNorm"] = viol.where(viol.isin(["yes", "no"]))

    # Exceedance rate: fraction of samples with Violation == 'yes' among non-missing violation
    usable = df[df["violationNorm"].notna()].copy()
    usable["isExceed"] = usable["violationNorm"].eq("yes").astype(int)

    byYear = (
        usable.groupby("Year")
        .agg(totalSamples=("isExceed", "size"), exceedSamples=("isExceed", "sum"))
        .reset_index()
    )
    byYear["exceedRate"] = byYear["exceedSamples"] / byYear["totalSamples"]

    # Overall average exceedance rate across years (unweighted mean of annual rates)
    avgRate = byYear["exceedRate"].mean()
    byYear["avgRate"] = avgRate

    # Compare rounded-to-2dp rates as requested
    byYear["exceedRate2dp"] = byYear["exceedRate"].round(2)
    byYear["avgRate2dp"] = round(float(avgRate), 2)
    byYear["aboveAvg"] = byYear["exceedRate2dp"] > byYear["avgRate2dp"]

    return byYear.sort_values("Year")
